create_vasp_relax_inputs: create VASP relaxation input files from CIF structure files using PBE functional settings
create_vasp_static_inputs: create VASP static calculation input files from CIF structure files using PBE functional settings
create_input_generator: create a RelaxSetGenerator or StaticSetGenerator from an INCAR YAML configuration file
convert_cif_to_vasp: convert CIF crystal structure files to VASP input sets with POSCAR, INCAR, KPOINTS, and POTCAR
write_vasp_input_set: write VASP input files for a pymatgen structure to a specified output directory
